title: Persistent charged quantum halo: retrospective fixed-prediction comparison
status: Specified before this evaluator receives any final new charged-population or free-control predictions. Existing SPARC outcomes and model-development history have already been explored; not prospective registration.
free_control: Zero-contact quantum population, separately calibrated common m and same one-state-per-galaxy capacity, identical baryonic potential and inner objective. Retain as distinct mechanism control even if predictions coincide.
primary_sample: Original 131 SPARC galaxies and 659 outer rows. Full3034 input preferred; outer-only659 accepted and explicitly labeled. All seven required models must cover every original input key.
primary_loss: Mean pointwise squared standardized velocity residual within galaxy, then equal galaxy weight.
effect: Mean charged-minus-comparator galaxy loss; negative favors charged.
sign_probability: Two-sided independent fair-sign binomial probability conditional on informative galaxy pairs. Finite defeats failed; joint failures have no sign. Holm6 covers all six fixed contrasts.
finite_subset_seed_rule: Base finite_subset_seed plus zero-based comparator index. Profiled_baryons is index1 and therefore uses2026092614; record this actual seed when describing that subset.
interval: Marginal95% whole-galaxy pairs bootstrap-t, with percentile interval as secondary sensitivity; neither is simultaneous nor an inversion of adjusted wild tests.
wild_test: Two-sided null-imposed studentized mean-loss bootstrap d_g*=w_g*d_g, independent Rademacher multipliers, zero restricted intercept. Approximate mean-null test, not generally an exact sign-randomization test.
p_value: (exceedances+1)/(draws+1); report raw binomial Monte Carlo95% interval and explicit zero-exceedance resolution flag. Never extrapolate a zero count.
continuous_multiplicity: Six fixed slots; an undefined full-sample contrast receives no published p. Use conservative internal p=1 placeholder only while Holm-adjusting other valid contrasts.
failure_policy: Any explicit fit_failed flag anywhere in a supplied galaxy/model block, or nonfinite/negative outer predicted speed, invalidates that galaxy/model. Keep all131 in failure-aware signs. Full-sample continuous contrast is undefined if either model fails. Report jointly feasible subset effect/CI separately without primary p. Never impute a finite failure penalty or silently drop it.
inference_gate: Root supplies final frozen predictions only after declared numerical, branch and retained-regime checks. A statistical pass does not certify charge-sector persistence, field stability or applicability.
uncertainty_scope: Saved predictions conditioned upon; no refitting, no common-m or individual-state estimation uncertainty, no inherited nuisance propagation, no covariance estimation, no shared survey/systematic correction, no historical model-selection correction. Common fitted coefficients induce dependence not represented by frozen-prediction bootstrap.
physical_scope: Stationary states and a conserved charge are not a predicted population-formation or charge-supply law. Neither sign probabilities nor Gaussian equivalents detect the cubic mechanism, exclude GR or establish formation.
bounds_scope: Report microscopic/state boundary hits and domains separately from scores. No boundary extension, branch selection, changed failure policy or changed weight after seeing outer scores.
secondary_descriptions: equal-galaxy MAE km/s and mean absolute standardized residual
median and symmetric10% trimmed paired effects
assumed equicorrelation rho0,.25,.5,.75 without refitting or new p
gaussian_equivalent: Unsigned two-sided normal equivalent norm.isf(p/2); state which model is favored; a large Z can favor the comparator.
predictions_interface: galaxy,index,radius,observed,sigma,is_outer,model,predicted; optional but recommended fit_failed and failure_reason. Original aliases point_index,radius_kpc,observed_kms,sigma_kms,predicted_kms are accepted. Catalogue coordinates, radius in kpc and speeds/errors in km/s.
fixed_observational_reference: ../../pointwise_comparison_2026_09_25/data/pointwise_all.csv relative to this statistics directory; validate original galaxy/index/radius/observed/sigma/split.
